squatsTechnique: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower slowly as if sitting in an imaginary chair, keep your back straight and knees aligned with your toes. Rise by pushing with your heels.
squatsTips: Keep your chest up, don't let your knees go past your toes, breathe deeply.
deadliftsTechnique: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart over the bar, squat and grip the bar with hands apart. Keep your back straight, push with your legs to lift the bar, keep the bar close to your body.
deadliftsMuscles: Lower back, glutes, hamstrings, traps, forearms
deadliftsTips: Keep your back neutral, don't round your lower back, use a lifting belt if necessary.
benchPressTechnique: Lie on the bench, grip the bar with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower the bar controllably until it touches your chest, then push up until your arms are extended.
benchPressTips: Keep your feet planted on the floor, arch your lower back slightly, don't bounce the bar off your chest.
lungesTechnique: Step forward with one leg, lower until both knees are at 90 degrees. The front thigh should be parallel to the floor. Push with the front heel to return to the starting position.
lungesTips: Keep your torso upright, don't let the front knee go past your toes, alternate legs.
pullUpsTechnique: Hang from the bar with hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing out. Pull your body up until your chin passes the bar, then lower controllably.
pullUpsTips: Avoid swinging, focus on using your back, if you can't do full pull-ups use resistance bands.
pushUpsTechnique: Get into plank position with hands shoulder-width apart. Lower your body until your chest almost touches the floor, then push up.
pushUpsTips: Keep your body in a straight line, don't let your hips sag, breathe controllably.
legPressTechnique: Sit in the machine, place feet on the platform shoulder-width apart. Unlock the safeties and bend knees to 90 degrees, then push the platform away.
legPressTips: Don't fully lock your knees, control the lowering movement, adjust foot width based on desired focus.
rowsTechnique: Sit in the rowing machine, grip the handles. Pull the handles toward your torso keeping elbows close to your body, then extend arms controllably.
rowsTips: Keep your back straight, squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of the movement, control both the pull and the release.
dipsTechnique: Position yourself between two parallel bars, lower your body by bending elbows until shoulders are below elbows, then push up.
dipsTips: Keep elbows pointing backward, don't let shoulders drop, control the movement.
calfRaisesTechnique: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, raise heels off the ground contracting your calves, hold the position for one second, then lower controllably.
calfRaisesTips: Keep knees slightly bent, focus on complete contraction, can be done standing or seated.
